purpose: Independent source-backed development cases from recent documentaries. Documentary pages establish the title and release; official court, police, transportation-safety, and government records establish each event anchor and hard outcome.

benchmark_policy.selection_use: May be used for house-system model selection, but not as a holdout or as evidence of real-world forensic validity.
benchmark_policy.contamination_note: The fixture was added for the August 2026 development replay and is immediately considered development data. Any reported score on it is in-sample after the first replay.
benchmark_policy.anchor_rule: Never invent a death time. Use an official incident interval midpoint, occurrence time, response marker, or exact transport impact time and label the proxy explicitly.

target_definition.axis_target: Documented event family and scene context, not the documentary's narrative framing.
target_definition.survivability_target: The stated direct-victim or occupant group. Cases without a defensible denominator are left unscored for survivability.
target_definition.scope_note: Aggregate event-chart replay cannot establish an individual's survival probability and is used only as a symbolic engine regression test.

event_anchor.notes: Midpoint of the official 4:00-4:25 a.m. homicide window. It is not asserted as any victim's exact time of death. Coordinates are an address-level geocode, not a survey point.

known_facts.scene: occupied off-campus residence at 1122 King Road
known_facts.observation_context: one surviving roommate reported seeing a masked person inside the house

hard_outcome.outcome: four homicide deaths and four first-degree murder convictions

relationship_target.meaning: No intimate-partner, family, or friend relationship is established in the benchmark sources. This broad label does not assert motive, random selection, or the absence of every prior contact.

comparison_policy.notes: An unestablished relationship is unknown, not a verified negative. Relationship labels therefore remain observations and are excluded from the hard score.

fact_checks.fact: The documented event was a four-victim stabbing homicide.
The documented event family was intentional homicide, not an accident or disaster.
The victims were found in the residence and the documented cause and manner was homicide by stabbing, not a water event.
The four victims were found inside the residence; this benchmark event was not an abduction or missing-person event.
The four victims were ages 20, 20, 21, and 21.
All four members of the direct-victim group died.
